mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly GDP growth above 2% in the prior quarter predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns due to increased corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDP growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate Fed rate hikes to curb inflation.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.5%, or no Fed rate hike within 60 days post-crossing.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low FEDFUNDS (<1%) and strong quarterly GDP growth (>3%) interact to predict positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate accommodative policy and robust growth.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both conditions are met, or FEDFUNDS rises above 1% within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO exceeding 105 signals robust supply-side growth, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through expanded production capacity and demand.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO exceeds 105, or no sustained growth in production indices.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE falling below 4% triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate labor market strengthening and improved corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE drops below 4%, or no subsequent improvement in labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: Low FEDFUNDS (<1%) and low CPIAUCSL (<2.0%) interact to predict positive 20-day S&P 500 returns during deflationary expectations as investors seek value in equities.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both conditions are met, or FEDFUNDS rises above 1% within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate prolonged accommodative policy.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle periods when FEDFUNDS decline, or no sustained accommodative policy continuation.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS > 150k) and falling unemployment (UNRATE <4%) interact to predict positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as labor market tightness boosts corporate profits.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both conditions are met, or labor market conditions revert before the horizon.
